title: Closeout summary: Object-store writes can report failure after durable mutation succeeds
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Post-commit cache failures are now swallowed after durable object/log success, the cache is invalidated best-effort, and an injected failure regression proves the write remains successful and readable.

Close reason: Durable mutations no longer return failure solely because the disposable index update failed.
